description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a Data Model (DM) client, including the dmClient, dmProviderProxy, and dmClientNotifier classes, used for managing data queries, notifications, and proxy interactions.

classes.name: dmProviderProxy
classes.description: Class representing a proxy for provider operations, currently empty with only public scope.

classes.name: dmClientNotifier
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about query results and errors from the dmClient.

classes.name: dmClient
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for data model client operations, including running queries and creation/destruction methods.

methods.name: dmClient::~dmClient
methods.description: Destructor for dmClient, virtual to allow proper cleanup of derived classes.

methods.name: dmClient::runQuery
methods.description: Pure virtual function to initiate a data model query with specified operation, parameter, and recursion flag; notifications are handled via dmClientNotifier.
